text:
Olivia Park: Quick thought  run a Lunchtime Spotlight Roadshow next Wed 11:30-1:30 across 3 floors to coincide with mid-cycle check-ins. Mini certificates + 25 $25 gift cards + swag stickers. Budget cap $1,500. Who can help with logistics + pickup?
Damien Lee: I can pick up gift cards and certificates Mon afternoon. What's vendor/location?
Olivia Park: Vendor is OfficeHub (Dock C). Pickup window Mon 2-4pm. Need someone to print 120 certificate templates and laminate ~30. Also want a 1-line PR blurb for managers.
Sofia Gomez: I can print & laminate 30 certificates Tue morning. Will need the final template. Also can design a tiny poster A4 with QR to the nomination form.
Olivia Park: Poster text: "Lunchtime Spotlight  Nom a teammate for a quick spot award!" Keep inclusive language. QR -> https://redwood.internal/nom/spotlight
Kai Tran: I'll volunteer 11:30-12:30 floor 2 and help with tablet + Google form. Can someone run the public recognition opt-in flow?
PayrollBot: Payroll note: Gift cards are taxable as cash-equivalents. Use expense code SPOT-ROAD-2026 and submit PAY_REQ within 3 business days. For certificates/swags, use POPUP-MARKET-2026. Receipts required: https://redwood.internal/payroll/policy :memo:
Damien Lee: Noted. I'll pick up cards Mon 2:15pm and upload receipt. My phone: 555-0188. Can someone confirm manager checklist items so approvals are complete during roadshow?
Sofia Gomez: Checklist idea: recipient full name, one-line impact, manager sign-off checkbox, public post OK checkbox, desired award type (card/certificate/swag). I'll add it to the form.
Olivia Park: Volunteers needed: floor 3 11:30-12:30, floor 2 12:30-1:30. Confirmed: @Kai 11:30-12:30, @Sofia 12:30-1:30. Need one more for floor 3.
Kai Tran: I can swap to floor 3 if @Sofia wants 12:30-1:30 on floor 2.
Sofia Gomez: I'll do floor 2 12:30-1:30. Damien, can you handle floor 3 midday?
Damien Lee: Yep happy to cover floor 3 11:30-12:30 and run tablets.
Olivia Park: Calendar event created: "Lunchtime Spotlight Roadshow" Wed 11:30-13:30. RSVP & packing checklist in event. I'll post a short reminder Tue 8am. :sparkles:
PayrollBot: Reminder set: expense reminder 7 days after pickup. Automated payroll guidance link included in event.
Olivia Park: Thanks team. Small note  keep nomination blurbs to one sentence for the public feed. We'll verify consent before posting. I'll DM the final cert template tonight.
